closureRule: A defect is RESOLVED only when the remediation and its direct evidence exist. Final candidate acceptance remains Scott's decision.

defects.title: Adversarial audit was incomplete and contained closure placeholders
defects.resolution: All required audit sections are being completed and the final DOCX is generated only after immutable validation.

defects.title: Forty-eight directive statement units had no explicit reconciliation disposition
defects.resolution: Every discovered unit is now represented in the schema-v3 reconciliation ledger and maps to issued records.

defects.title: Twenty compound source requirements were not split into independently testable records
defects.resolution: Each source parent is preserved as a superseded lineage parent and 190 stable atomic child IDs carry the separable obligations.

defects.title: PES-REQ-0003 verbatim field contained implementation-added table prefixes
defects.resolution: The source-fidelity field is regenerated without the added prefix and is guarded by exact extraction checks.

defects.title: Integrity verification compared the subject with a manifest recomputed from the same subject
defects.resolution: The launcher now extracts an immutable Git-object manifest outside the subject and seals it by SHA-256; final proof requires the closure candidate commit.

defects.title: Editor-configuration mutation escaped the prior verifier
defects.resolution: Exact-project-file-set integrity now detects the byte mutation through VER-INT-0002.

defects.title: External URL insertion escaped the prior verifier
defects.resolution: Narrow production/config scopes are scanned and the prescribed mutation maps to VER-OFF-0001.

defects.title: Loopback endpoint insertion escaped the prior verifier
defects.resolution: Narrow production/config scopes are scanned and the prescribed mutation maps to VER-OFF-0002.

defects.title: Vendor-facing product text insertion escaped the prior verifier
defects.resolution: Exact user-facing scopes are scanned for the controlled mark list and the mutation maps to VER-BRN-0001.

defects.title: A risk could be marked closed without admissible closure evidence
defects.resolution: VER-RSK-0001 now requires complete linked evidence, verification, change control, reviewer, date, rationale, and residual risk.

defects.title: Deleting ADR-0001 crashed the prior verifier instead of producing a controlled failure
defects.resolution: Missing ADRs are handled as named VER-ADR-0001 policy failures with exit code 1 and no uncaught exception.

defects.title: Historical normalized render digest was malformed at 62 hexadecimal characters
defects.resolution: The raw page text was recomputed reproducibly and the correct 64-character digest is recorded without rewriting historical evidence.

defects.title: Canonical filenames and controlling-document model conflicted
defects.resolution: CR-0001 records Scott's separate-phase-directive model and subsequent reference-folder relocation while preserving exact filenames and hashes.

defects.title: Repository lacked preserved pre-remediation Git history
defects.resolution: The starting tree is preserved by a full commit and annotated phase1-pre-remediation-v1 tag before corrective edits.

defects.title: CI was disabled and there was no complete shared closure gate
defects.resolution: The checked-in workflow is active for push, pull request, and manual dispatch and invokes the exact local gate without evidence upload.

defects.title: The Phase 1 repository had no runnable technical foundation
defects.resolution: A bounded React-to-typed-contract-to-Worker-to-real-Rust/WASM health round trip now builds and runs offline without PLC features.

defects.title: Historical audit stated that scratch evidence had been deleted although it still existed
defects.resolution: The exact scratch material was preserved under pre-remediation evidence and the historical statement is explicitly labeled as historical rather than silently altered.

defects.title: Empty asset and dependency checks could pass vacuously or contradict actual source use
defects.resolution: The shipped asset count remains truthfully zero; evidence paths/hashes are exact, direct dependency declarations are fully enumerated, and unauthorized or network-capable declarations fail closed.

defects.title: Toolchain and dependency legal, provenance, and security admission is incomplete
defects.resolution: Candidate use is exact-version, bounded, local, non-release, and labeled CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED; release admission remains external.

defects.title: Historical directive status wording does not match PES-ACC-0005 exactly
defects.resolution: The source remains immutable; CR-0001 resolves document sequencing but does not authorize rewriting the historical DOCX.

defects.title: No remote repository or hosted CI execution evidence exists
defects.resolution: The active configuration and exact local gate are in scope; remote creation, push, hosted execution, logs, upload, and retention remain blocked by DEC-0002.
